purpose: Signal-domain reference for the image comparison (docs/ROADMAP_Q1.md, item 2): how much discrimination the paper-image representation costs. Same 21,388 ECGs, labels, official patient folds, row order, training loop, hyperparameters, selection rule, threshold, test policy and bootstrap as the image networks; only the input differs (raw 100 Hz waveforms instead of rendered pages). Frozen before any signal model was trained. It is a reference, not a member of the controlled image-head comparison; the model is a standard Wang-style 1D ResNet and much larger than the image heads.
cohort_and_order: rows of the v1 image cache (data/processed/ptbxl_lead_images_v1) for each split, in that order; labels and patient IDs taken from those rows
source: PTB-XL v1.0.3 records100 (filename_lr), read with wfdb; every .dat/.hea file checked against the dataset's SHA256SUMS.txt

preprocessing.leads: I, II, III, aVR, aVL, aVF, V1-V6 (PTB-XL order)
preprocessing.units: mV as stored; no filtering, resampling or cropping
preprocessing.normalization: per-lead mean and standard deviation from training signals only

model.name: resnet1d_wang
model.definition: Wang et al. 2017 time-series ResNet: three residual blocks (64, 128, 128 channels), each conv k=8, k=5, k=3 with BatchNorm and ReLU, 1x1 projection shortcut when channels change; global average pooling, dropout, linear 5-logit readout
model.reference: Wang, Yan and Oates, IJCNN 2017; used as resnet1d_wang in Strodthoff et al., IEEE JBHI 2021 (PTB-XL benchmark)

training_loop: src/training/ptbxl_trainer.py train_model, unchanged; the runner registers the model and points the loop's input-shape check at 12 x 1000 at run time (src/run_ptbxl_signal.py)
loss: unweighted binary cross entropy with logits; five independent binary targets
selection_rule: Strict lexicographic maximum of validation (macro_roc_auc, macro_average_precision, -probability_binary_cross_entropy); earliest epoch on exact tie
threshold_policy: fixed sigmoid probability >=0.5; no threshold search
test_policy: One test inference per run after the selected checkpoint is frozen and reloaded. Fold 10 was already observed for earlier PTB-XL models, so the comparison is exploratory; no test-based tuning.

uncertainty.method: patient-cluster percentile bootstrap of final test predictions
uncertainty.scope: test-sampling uncertainty conditional on this fitted model; excludes seed/training/external-domain variation

concurrency_note: Seeds run on the same GPU as the fixed-gain seed 43/44 queue; runtimes are not controlled speed measurements
